integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible symbolic checker; optional discretized linear programs are diagnostics rather than infinite-dimensional certificates. No independent validation.
limitations: Real signed measures, two strictly interior opposite-sign atoms, exactly four ordinary moments, and unweighted total variation on [-1,1]. No stability, higher-degree or complex-amplitude assertion. Prior equivalent low-degree formulation might be unindexed.
title: Sharp four-moment recovery frontier for signed two-atom measures
